1511501.name: Toxic Bullet
1511501.description:
Fires a toxic bullet from its back, dealing damage to a single Nikke.
Deals additional damage if the attack hits.

1511502.name: Contaminated Projectile
1511502.description:
Launches a barrage of projectiles, dealing damage to multiple Nikkes.
Deals significant sustained damage if the attack hits more than once.
Can be interrupted by destroying the Poison Chamber.

1511504.name: Shock Wave
1511504.description: Ultra smashes the ground, dealing massive damage to all Nikkes.

1511505.name: Toxic Shells
1511505.description:
Spews toxic shells from its mouth that can pierce through cover, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
Deals significant sustained damage if the attack hits.
Generates a code barrier to defend against attacks before spewing the toxic shells.
While the barrier is up, only Water Code Nikkes can deal damage.

1511506.name: Toxic Dust
1511506.description: Collects and shoots toxic dust, dealing massive damage to multiple Nikkes.

1511508.name: Toxic Substance Spray
1511508.description: Ejects a powerful toxic substance from its entire body. This attack must be interrupted via Special Interruption; otherwise, it deals massive damage to all Nikkes.

1511515.name: Toxic Wave
1511515.description: Ultra unleashes multiple toxic waves, dealing damage to a single Nikke.
